description: Origin airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Forms the route key together with dest; only the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA)

description: Destination airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Includes one unusual route, EWR to LGA, with a single cancelled flight

description: Number of flights observed for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Count of flight records grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Includes cancelled flights; ranges from 1 to 11,262; 10 routes have fewer than 10 flights, so their averages are unstable

description: Mean departure delay for the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of recorded departure delays grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA, whose only flight was cancelled. Same-season departure delays are unavailable at schedule planning time and would leak information into the model.

description: Average arrival delay for flights on the route, in minutes (target)
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Averages only flights with a recorded arrival delay; missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); negative means early on average

description: Largest recorded arrival delay for the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Maximum recorded arrival delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA. A negative maximum means all recorded arrivals were early. Same-season values share the target's source and would leak information into a planning model.

description: Mean reported flight distance for the route, in miles
transformation_or_derivation: Mean distance grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Distance is available before departure. The average summarizes only records in this dataset.

description: Mean observed time in the air for the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of recorded air times grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA. Observed air time for the season is available only after flights operate and should be excluded from a preseason model.

description: Full name of the destination airport
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 7 routes whose destination (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT) is not in the airports table

description: Destination airport latitude, in decimal degrees
transformation_or_derivation: Left join airport latitude where dest matches faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing on seven routes to BQN, PSE, SJU, and STT because those codes are absent from the reference table.

description: Destination airport longitude, in decimal degrees
transformation_or_derivation: Left join airport longitude where dest matches faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing on seven routes to BQN, PSE, SJU, and STT because those codes are absent from the reference table.
